snippet.title: City States: Medieval | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist City States: Medieval on Steam Today:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4066390/City_States_Medieval/?curator_clanid=38337724 

You are the leader of a city-state in high medieval Europe. Expand your city through deep city-building systems, build a trade empire across the known world, and lead men to war to defend trade routes in a high-stakes struggle of global strategy and brutal tower defense warfare.
